notes: The first name is the compiler's own name, written here because the text writes him as a transmitter (rule 13); a reviewer should check it against the compiler head
«سألت جعفر بن محمد» : Abd Allah asks the Imam, so the Imam is the one asked (rule 5), named in the words (imam_in_text). His «حدثني أبي، عن أبيه» gives two bare relations, not identified
«خالها عبد الله بن منصور» : maternal uncle with a name is one link (rule 7)
Epithets left out: «الشيخ الجليل الفاضل», «الحافظ» (after Muhammad b. Umar), «قاضي بلخ», «وكانت عمتي», «وكان رضيعا...»
